headline: Steady Volume Growth; Margins Pinched by Input Costs

highlights: FMCG 1 Steady Volume Growth; Margins Pinched by Input Costs Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – INLINE Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 0%/0%; EBITDA: -7%/-7%; PAT: -8%/-7% Recommendation Rationale • Healthy Growth: Britannia delivered a steady performance in Q2FY27, reporting a 17% YoY increase in revenue to Rs 5,542 Cr, supported by 13% volume growth.
However, elevated input costs arising from the West Asia conflict weighed on margins.
General Trade witnessed healthy traction, with growth accelerating to 2.6x the FY26 rate, while alternate channels expanded at 1.8x the pace of General Trade.
valuation: Result Update 09th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 5,575 Britannia Industries Ltd.

With sugar prices expected to remain elevated through the festive season, management is partially mitigating margin pressures through targeted grammage reductions. • Demand Outlook: Management indicated that planned grammage reductions could weigh on volumes in the near term.
